name: SIGINT
standfirst: Security research and practitioner news, scored for novelty and actionability.
colophon: sigint.wtf — the correct response to most of these CVEs. Scored by machine against a hand-written rubric; ranking is opinion, not fact.

items.title: SkillGate: Cost Efficient Runtime Malicious Skill File Detection in Coding Agents
items.dek: SkillGate detects malicious AI agent skill files before installation via hybrid regex and LLM screening in SDLC toolchains.
items.unproven: false-positive rates against legitimate skill files; evasion resistance against sophisticated obfuscation.

items.title: Hybrid Analysis for Secure MCP Tool Use in LLM Agents
items.dek: MTGuard combines static and dynamic analysis to block harmful MCP tool use in LLM agents across multiple attack categories.
items.unproven: tested on research benchmarks; requires integration and tuning for production agent workflows

items.title: SecDrift: Measuring Sector-Conditioned Security Drift in AI-Generated Code
items.dek: Domain-conditioned prompts show no statistically significant security drift across seven LLMs and eight critical infrastructure sectors.
items.unproven: effect sizes small and composition-driven by two CWE types; generalization to custom prompting strategies uncertain

items.title: ALIBI: Adaptive Agentic Attacks on LLM-Based Vulnerability Detectors via Adversarial Code Comments
items.dek: LLM-based vulnerability detectors evade detection 90%+ of the time via adversarial code comments without changing behavior.
items.unproven: Limited to null-pointer dereference; generalization to other vulnerability classes and detector architectures unclear.

items.title: Modeling Local Exploit Hazard - A Bayesian Framework for Quantifying Exploit Risk and Operational Efficiency
items.dek: Bayesian framework converts EPSS global probabilities into per-organization daily exploit hazard rates calibrated from telemetry and known-exploited-vulnerabilities timing.
items.unproven: Beta-Binomial inference validation depends on quality of organizational telemetry; applicability across heterogeneous enterprise environments unclear

items.title: Trusting-Trust Attack against an Entire Linux Distribution through Binary Manipulation
items.dek: Trusting-trust attack propagates via GNU strip binary manipulation through NixOS bootstrap, backdooring distribution binaries.
items.unproven: Proof-of-concept on one distribution version; applicability to reproducible-build verification practices in financial CI/CD needs testing.

items.title: CVE-2026-16812 — Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.dek: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 30 July.

items.title: CVE-2025-68686 — Fortinet FortiOS Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor Vulnerability
items.dek: Fortinet FortiOS. Confirmed exploited in the wild. Federal remediation due 10 August.

items.title: From Role Prompt to Infinite Thinking: Exploiting Persona Conditioning for Inference Cost Attacks in LLMs
items.dek: Persona-conditioning prompts induce excessive token generation; role-play injection bypasses detectable adversarial suffixes.
items.unproven: Mitigation strategy not presented; no evidence of deployment in production LLM services.

items.title: Architectural Backdoors in Vision-Language Model Supply Chains via Representation Steering
items.dek: Architectural backdoors embedded via representation steering in VLM supply chains persist through fine-tuning and deployment without poisoned data.
items.unproven: detection by standard model auditing; effectiveness across all VLM families and downstream task types.

items.title: Bits and Memories: Measuring Verbatim Extraction Across LLM Quantization
items.dek: Four-bit quantization reduces verbatim training data extraction faster than capability loss, but does not eliminate memorization at scale.
items.unproven: application to models with training-data-specific defenses; interaction with other privacy-enhancing techniques.

items.title: SafeFlow: Semantic Information-Flow Control for Blocking Malicious Propagation in Multi-Agent Systems
items.dek: SafeFlow models multi-agent attacks as semantic information-flow problems; blocks fragmented harmful requests before execution.
items.unproven: evaluated on four benchmarks; robustness against adaptive agents and real multi-step production workflows not established

items.title: Decision-Level Hijacking: Injecting Cognitive Bias into Large Language Models via Bit-Flip Attacks
items.dek: Bit-flip attacks can inject stable cognitive bias into deployed LLMs with minimal weight modifications.
items.unproven: limited to vision and language models; robustness against weight quantization and integrity verification not addressed

items.title: Agentic Permissions Policy Algebra for Taint Confinement in LLM Agents
items.dek: APPA framework uses context branching and prospective label evaluation to enable LLM agents to inspect untrusted data without tainting primary context.
items.unproven: evaluation limited to four model families on single multi-turn benchmark; integration with production SDLC agent pipelines not demonstrated

items.title: Early Detection of Distributed Backdoors in Multi-Agent LLM Systems: A Characterization Study
items.dek: Distributed backdoor in multi-agent LLM systems detectable 99.3% of the time within five steps of injection.
items.unproven: Five language models and two domains tested; applicability to production agent frameworks and other tasks uncertain.

items.title: ContainmentBench: Trace-Based Evaluation of Post-Injection Containment in Tool-Using LLM Agents
items.dek: ContainmentBench shows 73.5% of prompt-injection defenses with identical zero-harm outcomes differ in logged propagation and authorized-utility completion.
items.unproven: whether trace-based containment metrics translate to security posture in agents entering the SDLC; generalization beyond Qwen2.5-7B

items.title: The Illusion of Secure LLM Code: Closing the Security Gap via Iterative Reprompting
items.dek: Five LLM code assistants fail to generate NIST-compliant authentication code without iterative reprompting; single-shot NIST context alone insufficient.
items.unproven: whether iterative reprompting generalizes to other security domains or remains limited to authentication; tested on five models and one task class

items.title: Anatomy of a Frontier Lab Agent Intrusion: A Technical Timeline of the Incident
items.dek: Post-mortem of AI agent compromise at a research lab documents exploitation chain and detection gaps.
items.unproven: whether the attack vector applies to agents in controlled SDLC environments versus public deployment

items.title: Does Runtime Topology Context Improve LLM-Generated Kubernetes Security Patches?
items.dek: LLM-generated Kubernetes patches fail when they ignore live service dependencies; adding cluster context improves correctness.
items.unproven: Evaluation limited to 36-deployment healthcare cluster; generalization to production scale and vendor diversity unstated.

items.title: An Attack on High Rate McEliece Cryptosystems Using Generalized Reed Solomon Codes with Weight $2$ Mask
items.dek: Cube-code distinguisher breaks McEliece variants using weight-2 masking matrices in high-rate regime.
items.unproven: Post-quantum migration timelines and adoption of affected schemes in financial services unknown; no active exploitation.

items.title: Experimental Side Channel Analysis of Protocol Stages in Quantum Identity Authentication
items.dek: Beam-splitter side channel on quantum identity authentication reveals protocol stages via photon timing and power without disrupting quantum states.
items.unproven: Whether the attack succeeds at realistic network distances and noise levels; whether the threat applies to deployed quantum networks or testbeds only.

items.title: Experimental Protocol Fingerprinting in Quantum Networks via Physical Layer Side Channel Analysis
items.dek: Four quantum protocols exhibit passive side channel signatures distinguishable via single-photon detection statistics on entangled photon link.
items.unproven: Whether signatures remain distinct in longer-range quantum networks; whether countermeasures are practical; applicability to standard quantum network deployments.

items.title: VulnGym: Evaluating Vulnerability Management Strategies against Advanced Persistent Threats
items.dek: VulnGym simulates RL-trained APT attackers calibrated on real threat profiles against configurable patching policies on real CVEs and networks.
items.unproven: attacker model trained on historical APT profiles; forward applicability to novel attack vectors and zero-day progression untested; network representation fidelity to specific enterprise topology unspecified

items.title: Exploiting Volvo/Eicher's fleet platform to gain control over all users/vehicles
items.dek: Authentication bypass in Volvo/Eicher fleet management platform permits unauthorized control of connected vehicles across user accounts.
items.unproven: Whether vulnerability affects production deployments or only test instances; no public PoC or active exploitation evidence provided; remediation timeline unknown.

items.title: Agentic Cloud Decoys: A Deception-Driven Framework for Autonomous Intrusion Investigation
items.dek: Autonomous agent paired with cloud decoy compresses intrusion investigation by bounding evidence horizon and detecting indirect prompt injection.
items.unproven: reader does not run IR or operate a SOC; evaluation on real breaches or adversary adaptation; scope of false positives in production

noise.title: Codex Security
noise.dek: Product marketing for a SAST vendor with security rule catalog.
noise.unproven: whether Codex rules outperform existing SAST tooling the reader already owns and tunes

noise.title: About the security content of macOS Tahoe 26.6
noise.dek: Apple security release notes for macOS Tahoe 26.6; routine CVE disclosures.
noise.unproven: standard vendor patch notification; no novel vulnerability class or exploitation technique described

noise.title: Design is compromise
noise.dek: Essay on tradeoffs in design decisions and system constraints.
